description: PLANNED adapter — Aider is NOT installed and NOT wired into the harness. This descriptor is a design-only sketch of how an Aider worker WOULD present the same interface if it were ever admitted: run in its own worktree, edit only within a lease, commit locally, and hand off a branch for the sheriff to review. Nothing here installs, launches, or authorizes Aider. Admitting it later would still require its own argv/contract proof and the standard founder gates; this spec removes re-derivation, never verification.

input_contract.mission: PLANNED: a single scoped mission would be passed as Aider's task message.
lease_globs: PLANNED: the lane's file-lease glob(s), enforced by the harness, not by Aider itself
input_contract.branch: PLANNED: a harness-assigned foundergate/<slug> branch; the worker stays on it.
hard_exclusions: no unattended network egress beyond its own model endpoint (which is itself a gate)

artifacts: PLANNED: files inside the assigned lease only
expected_outputs.commit_message_convention: PLANNED: a proof(...) subject with the required Co-Authored-By trailer

pr_handoff.body_convention: PLANNED: harness-standard PR-body trailer; a GATE REPORT block when a true founder gate appears.

integration_evidence: PLANNED / NOT-INSTALLED: Aider is not present in this environment and has no live harness wiring.
PLANNED: this descriptor is a design-only sketch; admitting Aider requires its own argv/contract proof + founder gates before status could ever become 'real'.
